decision.requirement: Use normal observations to review cost, retain unknowns, and preserve original owner authority. Slow timing alone does not establish waste or authorize repair.
decision.mechanism: test_manager._run_suite emits module timing; cost_telemetry.timing_log normalizes observations; project validates, deduplicates, merges bounded wall intervals and calls review_cost; schema_manager.project_cost binds the review to subject and sources; project_owner_feedback retains original owner next. Source path only, not observed execution.
decision.consequence: Failed/refused phases or repeated named module observations request current owner readback; outputs retain effects=[], test_demand=null and authorizes_landing=false. Missing measurements and effectiveness remain unknown.
decision.alternative: Hypothetical fixed-duration repair threshold and simple sum of all durations. Neither alternative was executed.
decision.tradeoff: Readback retains task context and prevents slow required work from becoming unsupported repair, but needs owner interpretation. Interval union represents overlapping wall time correctly at the cost of timestamp availability and sorting; inclusive worker/phase totals remain separate.

outcome.observation: Selected source hashes matched. The inspected branches support separation of cost evidence and effects, conservative unknowns and overlap-aware wall timing. No implementation execution or agent behavior was observed.

lesson.applies_when: Cost observations include overlapping work or repeats whose necessity depends on task inputs, and a separate owner controls effects. Support is limited to this source design.
lesson.counterexample: A repeated verification run after changed inputs may be necessary. A separate established defect may justify authorized owner repair; cost review must not become an added delay or gate.
lesson.next_check: For a particular repeated run, inspect the two bound inputs, required behavior and current owner readback. For agent behavior, obtain one before/action/result/adjustment episode. Inspect the existing relevant cost/schema controls and results before claiming runtime enforcement.

role_feedback.architecture: Retain the separate observation, review and transition-owner boundaries; assessment.md Finding 1.

role_feedback.attention_to_detail: Keep wall intervals, worker seconds, inclusive phases, token data and projection milliseconds distinct; assessment.md Finding 2.
